sophia: Quick note 35 5seeing intermittent 403s for images in the KB staging preview. Scan found a cluster under /kb/runbooks and /kb/onboarding. Anyone on-call for those pages? :wave:
scan-bot: scan-bot: 2024-06-12T10:02:00Z - automated image-scan: 12 failures (403) across 9 pages. Report: /internal/scans/8551
noah: I'll take runbooks. Are these images blocked by ACLs on origin?
sophia: Looks like origin bucket had a permissions policy roll earlier this week. Some objects stayed private. We should rehost public KB images to CDN and set public-read for the new objects.
mia: I'll own onboarding and runtime pages. Drop the list and I'll open a PR to swap URLs and add alt text.
david: FYI, let's also add a short comment in the affected runbooks about where images are served from (so future editors don't accidentally upload to the wrong bucket). I can do the staging smoke test after merge.
noah: Plan: 1) copy affected images to staging CDN bucket with Cache-Control: max-age=86400 (screenshots) 2) update markdown references 3) include alt text and a brief commit message noting cache headers 4) PR -> reviewers @mia @david
sophia: Example sed to replace hosts in markdown:```sh
sed -n "s|https://s3.internal.redwood|https://cdn.redwood-infer.com|g" -l $(git grep -l "s3.internal.redwood" -- "*.md")
```
noah: Opening branch rehost/8551 with 9 files changed. Tagging @mia for CR.
mia: Quick accessibility note: add descriptive alt text for screenshots (e.g., "Redis cache config snippet showing TTL settings") and mark decorative gifs with empty alt. I'll add checklist items in the PR description.
david: once merged I'll run the staging preview and report 200/200 for images. If any still 403, we can revert and investigate origin ACLs deeper.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started mirror job 2024-06-13T02:00:00Z job-id=replicate-8551. Monitor: /internal/jobs/replicate-8551
sophia: Thanks team 5. Targeting merge today. I'll also update the KB ownership tracker to reflect @noah and @mia for the affected pages. Ping here if you find anything else.
